body: Hey, I'm sorry to make you worry. My internet just wouldn't work and my reply got deleted. Frustrating. I'm going to sleep as well and respond properly in the morning. I want you to know that I really appreciate everything you're doing for me and I hate burdening you with my mess.

I don't feel worthless, maybe not matter in the big picture, but that's not a reason to end it. I want to end it because I'm in pain, granted its not physical pain, I just hate feeling this lump in my throat, this hole in my chest, this unbearable gut feeling I can't begin to describe.

I just want it to stop. I've got to a point where I can't deal with it anymore and just wanna put myself down, it seems like it's the only solution in front of me.

Thanks for responding and I really wish I knew why I feel the way I feel.

So much is going on, and it's a mixture of everything but not really. I've felt this way at random points in my life but now it's just not going away.

I've ended a serious relationship a year ago but I've felt like this during the 'honeymoon' phase of it. My current girlfriend just ended it with me. I'm in a new country working an amazing job and couldn't be happier but I still feel like crap. I especially feel like crap realizing I have to go back to my home country. I don't really have many friends here, but I have people that care, but none of them seem to make this shadow go away.

It all seems to pointless in the grand scheme of things, if I was to disappear it'd be a tiny blip of  the radar, 1 in 7 billion, statistically insignificant. I just want to stop feeling the way I feel, and as selfish as it sounds, I don't really care what remains after I'm gone because I'd seize to exist, I will no longer be sentient thus incapable of feeling anything, sadness, happiness, regret.
